2026-10-17.headline: MythicSim re-ran its whole tier list on the 15 Oct build. Demonology Warlock still leads your three classes; Arcane joins Fire in the A band and Shadow climbs to 745.

items.text: Shadow Priest re-simmed at 745 DPS (was 704 on the old tier list, 739.7 on the race board), #14 of 24, B band.
Arcane moves up to #11 and the A band at 776 DPS, level with Fire (#10, 777). Frostfire drops to #13 (B), Frost to #19 (C).
Tier list now matches the Warlock page: Demonology #6 (852, A), Affliction #12 (756, B), Destruction #15 (704, B).
LFCarry lifts Shadow Priest from C to B after the Devouring Plague changes.
Tier set bonuses for Mage (Manaflare Regalia) and Shadow Priest (Raiments of Conviction) added to Gear. Shadow's 5-piece predates the Devouring Plague rework.
Raid bosses, attunements and group sizes added to Raids & dungeons. Onyxia keeps a per-character attunement; the new raids have none.
New Launch kit tab: ruleset choice, name reservation, addons and a checklist.

2026-10-18.headline: MythicSim re-simmed Mage on a 17 Oct engine and Arcane now leads Fire by 5% (837 vs 797), so Arcane takes over as the Mage pick. Demonology Warlock is still your strongest option at 853.

items.source: MythicSim Mage page and Arcane trinket board
items.text: Arcane Mage rises from 776 to 837 DPS on MythicSim's 17 Oct engine (0d17668) and replaces Fire as the Mage verdict. MythicSim hasn't said what changed.
Fire Mage goes from 777 to 797 DPS and Frost from 651 to 673; Frostfire stays at 743.
Demonology 852 to 853 DPS and Affliction 756 to 757 on the 17 Oct engine; Destruction stays at 704. The order and the 13% and 21% gaps are unchanged.
Skyborne now tops the Arcane race board (837.4, Human 0.08% behind), so it leads all four Mage specs; Human was top of Arcane before.
Demonology and Destruction race boards re-run: Human still leads both (852.1 and 704.6), with Orc within 0.81%.
Arcane's best trinkets on the new board: Talisman of Ephemeral Power +3.16% (was 3.28%), Cleansed Vilebranch Icon and Jewel of the Guard Captain +2.60% (was 2.57%).
The tier list itself has not moved: still the 16 Oct run, with Demonology #6, Fire #10, Arcane #11 and Shadow #14.
Blizzard (Kaivax) says art datamined from the latest beta build is not meant for WoW Forever.

2026-10-19.headline: MythicSim re-ran its sims over the weekend: Demonology Warlock still leads your three classes at 873 DPS, but Fire Mage has closed to about 1% behind Arcane (851 vs 861), so the two Mage specs are now close to level.

items.text: Fire Mage rises from 797 to 851 DPS and Arcane from 837 to 861 on MythicSim's 19 Oct engine (24c66df); Arcane stays the Mage pick, but only about 1% ahead.
Frostfire goes from 743 to 765 DPS and Frost from 673 to 690.
Demonology goes from 853 to 873 DPS, Affliction from 757 to 776 and Destruction from 704 to 721 on the 19 Oct Warlock page; the order and the gaps (about 12% and 21%) barely move.
Shadow Priest's newest run is the 18 Oct trinket board at 774 DPS (was 745 on the 16 Oct Priest page, which hasn't been re-run).

New tier list run (18 Oct, engine 08a6678): Arcane moves from #11 to #6 (776 to 861, an 11% jump from the new engine), Fire from #10 to #8, Frostfire from #13 to #12, and Frost from #19 to #17 and from C to B. Demonology slips from #6 to #7, Affliction from #12 to #13 and Destruction from #15 to #16 because Warlock rows still use the 17 Oct snapshot. Shadow stays #14 (745 to 753).
Elsewhere on the tier list, Fury Warrior and Shockadin Paladin drop from S to A, leaving only Survival and Marksmanship Hunter in S.
Race boards re-run: Human still leads every Warlock and the Shadow board, Skyborne every Mage board. Gnome moves up to S for Affliction and Fire, and Night Elf and Undead join S for Shadow.

New Affliction and Shadow trinket boards (18 Oct): the two quest trinkets lead both, Cleansed Vilebranch Icon and Jewel of the Guard Captain at +3.25% for Affliction (was 3.28%) and +2.44% for Shadow (was 2.46%).
A Warlock won the $100,000 Forever Open level-30 duel tournament and Warlocks took first and second; Mages gave them the hardest matches.
RestedXP's beta guide now routes through dungeons from level 1 to 30; its 35 to 60 routes still arrive after launch.
Added an older Blizzard post (13 Oct): accounts suspected of gold buying or selling can get a temporary hold on trade, mail, guild banks and the Auction House.
No new Blizzard build or development notes since 70450 (16 Oct); Server Slam is still 21 Oct at 6pm UK and launch 4 Nov.

2026-10-20.headline: Demonology Warlock is still the top spec of your three at 873 DPS and climbs from #7 to #5 on MythicSim's tier list. Watch the Mage pick: MythicSim's newest engine (20 Oct race boards) puts Arcane about 9% lower while Fire barely moves, so Fire may overtake Arcane on the next Mage page run.

items.text: Tier list moves the Warlock rows from the 17 Oct to the 18 Oct snapshot: Demonology goes from #7 to #5 (853 to 873 DPS), Affliction from #13 to #12 (757 to 776), and Destruction stays #16 (704 to 721).
Mage tier list rows keep their numbers (Arcane 861, Fire 851, Frostfire 765, Frost 690) but Fire moves from #8 to #7, Frostfire from #12 to #13 and Frost from #17 to #18 as other specs reshuffle.
Shadow Priest stays #14 on the tier list, now at 774 DPS instead of 753, matching its newest trinket board.

New 20 Oct race boards on engine 15b7435: Arcane's best race drops from 862.0 to 785.7 DPS (about 9%), while Fire's drops only from 850.7 to 844.8. The Mage page still shows Arcane 861 and Fire 851, so the verdict stays Arcane for now.
Human now edges Skyborne for Fire (844.8 vs 843.9, a tie within the sim's margin); Skyborne and Gnome tie for Arcane.
Destruction race board re-run (19 Oct): Human 704.6 to 721.4, and Gnome and Undead move from A to S alongside Orc.
Demonology trinket board re-run (18 Oct, baseline 873): the quest trinkets still lead at +3.00% (was 3.01%); Burst of Knowledge rises from 1.84% to 1.99% and Mindtap Talisman from 1.73% to 1.78%.

Elsewhere on the tier list, the Hunter rows moved to a 19 Oct run and fell 6 to 7% (Marksmanship 1000 to 927, down from S to A), leaving only Survival in S; Elehance Shaman rises to B and Balance Druid drops to C.
Blizzard released a video on two new levelling zones, the Riverglades (reached from Redridge Mountains) and Mount Hyjal; no level ranges yet.
Small beta fixes: Darnassus gets a mailbox by its Auction House and an invisible wall near the Stormwind Auction House is gone.
No new build or development notes since 70450 (16 Oct). Server Slam is still tomorrow, 21 Oct, at 6pm UK (19:00 CEST); name reservation opens 27 Oct.
